description.narrative: "The vision of Women In Front Cameroon is to build an inclusive society with differences, respecting the rights of women and girls, in which LBTQ women are recognized and taken into account in national policies developed in favor of women.The mission of Women in Front Cameroon is to respond to the most pressing needs in sexual and reproductive health, mental health and respect for the human rights of women and girls in Cameroon, including respect for sexual orientation and gender identity.The Equality Fund grant will be used to finance organizational operational expenses and part of operating costs. This grant also supports:-The implementation of advocacy and lobbying campaigns for the recognition of women's rights with local authorities, political actors, media actors, women's rights associations; for the equitable care of LBTQ women and girls in health facilities regardless of their gender identity;-Awareness-raising and education activities for LBTQ women and girls on their human rights, training them to recognize and denounce all forms of violence against them because of their gender; -WIFC offers services to beneficiaries in need, through online psychological and legal follow-ups and the travel of experts in the event of force majeure; in particular victims of gender-based violence."
